prompt: Choose the best sentence for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的句子。

options.text: For a Sunday deadline, a reply cannot secure a Tuesday pickup if someone else is waiting: cancellation hands the tool to the next member, and an extension cannot be granted.
options.zh: 若期限是星期日，且已有他人候補，單靠回覆無法把取件延到星期二：取消會把工具讓給下一位會員，而延期申請也無法獲准。
options.whyZh: 取消與申請延期用途不同，但兩者都不能使已有候補的工具留到星期二；後段的不開館安排也不會改變原期限。

options.text: If someone is already waiting, send a cancellation to keep the tool for another day.
options.zh: 如果已有人候補，寄出取消通知即可多保留一天。
options.whyZh: 取消會把工具交給下一位，不會讓原會員多保留一天。

options.text: An extension takes effect as soon as you reply even if nobody has checked the list.
options.zh: 一回覆便立即延期，不必等工作人員查候補名單。
options.whyZh: 須無人等候才可批准，送出申請不等於已核准。

options.text: The next person cannot be offered the tool until you have picked it up.
options.zh: 你取走工具之前，不能將工具提供給下一位候補者。
options.whyZh: 若工作人員及時收到取消訊息，就會把工具提供給下一位。

explanationZh: 取消與申請延期用途不同，但兩者都不能使已有候補的工具留到星期二；後段的不開館安排也不會改變原期限。

vocabulary.note: open day 指櫃檯實際營業的日子；不是一律多一天，也不是一回覆就核准。

evidence:
To: Members with a pickup notice
Subject: Releasing a hold

Your tool stays at the pickup desk for two open days after we send the notice. Bring your membership card so staff can verify your account.

If you no longer need the tool and want the next member to have it, you can release a hold by replying before it expires. A reply canceling your hold does not extend the pickup window. When staff receive that message before expiry, they offer the tool to the next person in line.

There is a separate option for members who still need the tool. Reply before expiry to ask for one extra open day. We can grant it only if nobody is waiting. For a Sunday deadline, a reply cannot secure a Tuesday pickup if someone else is waiting: cancellation hands the tool to the next member, and an extension cannot be granted.

The desk closes at 6 p.m. on open days, and it is closed on Mondays. A hold with a Sunday deadline will not remain active simply because Monday is not an open day.
